high_level_description: This image captures a serene beach scene during what appears to be either early morning or late evening, as suggested by the soft lighting and the position of the sun near the horizon. The sky is partly cloudy with hues of blue and pink, indicating the presence of sunrise or sunset. The beach itself is sandy and stretches along the foreground of the image. There are a few scattered objects on the sand, including what looks like a small pile of debris or trash. The waves gently lap against the shore, creating a rhythmic and calming effect.
